blocks.text:
Several days are set aside for a beach holiday.

Praia do Forte is around 85 km from Salvador, in the Mata de São João area.

The resort has beaches, coconut and mangrove groves, warm ocean water and stretches of fine golden sand.

blocks.text:
The area offers good conditions for surfing and diving.

There is a sea turtle sanctuary here. From September to March, you can see the season when baby turtles hatch and make their way to the water.

From June to October, whales can sometimes be seen off the coast.
